newsitem.title: CHINA: Population of China's capital exceeds 12 million.
newsitem.headline: Population of China's capital exceeds 12 million.

text.p: The number of registered residents in China's capital, Beijing, had exceeded 12 million by the end of 1996, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Wednesdasy.
The newspaper reported 100,700 births last year, with a birth rate of 8.02 per 1,000.
The registered residents of the city reached 12,594 million, an increase of 2.68 per 1,000, the newspaper said.
It gave no estimate for the number of unregistered residents, with tens of thousands of migrant labourers flooding into the city from rural areas across China in search of better paying jobs.
